sequence_column.title: Sequence column
sequence_column.description: Column containing aligned BCR nucleotide sequences (gapped or ungapped).

clone_id_column.title: Clone ID column
clone_id_column.description: Column used to group sequences into clones.

germline_id_column.title: Germline/allele column
germline_id_column.description: Column storing V germline IDs or alleles that BrepPhylo will map to its germline database.

label_column.title: Label column
label_column.description: Optional human-readable label for tips; falls back to sequence order if empty.

class_column.title: Class column
class_column.description: Optional column used by BrepPhylo for per-class colouring and palette generation.

class_palette.title: Class palette
class_palette.description: Optional explicit palette when class_column is set. Each entry defines a level and colour.

germline_colour.title: Germline colour
germline_colour.description: Colour used by BrepPhylo to render germline nodes.

tree_type.title: Tree builder
tree_type.description: Algorithm passed to treeConstruction$type (simple, dnapars, or igphyml).

collapse_and_replace.title: Collapse identical sequences (dnapars)
collapse_and_replace.description: If true, collapse identical sequences before parsimony reconstruction and re-expand afterwards.

igphyml_accuracy.title: IgPhyML accuracy preset
igphyml_accuracy.description: Accuracy preset passed to IgPhyML (e.g. 'basic', 'high', 'extreme'); leave blank for the BrepPhylo default.

min_clone_size.title: Minimum clone size
min_clone_size.description: Discard clones with fewer sequences than this threshold before tree building.

species.title: Species
species.description: Species identifier for selecting BrepPhylo germline references.

algorithm.title: Alignment algorithm
algorithm.description: Multiple sequence aligner; default (model) is ClustalOmega.

gather_plots.title: Gather plots
gather_plots.description: Gather individual clone plots into a combined PDF where supported.

use_temp_dir.title: Use per-run temp dir
use_temp_dir.description: Let BrepPhylo stage intermediate files in a temp directory inside the container.
